detail.longDescription: Anthropic has published FlashProve, an open source system giving cryptographic proof that a response really came from the model it claims. Lab fingerprints can be checked without exposing model weights, so providers cannot secretly swap in a cheaper or more capable model. Verification runs on a local device; no deployment planned yet. https:// techcrunch.com/2026/11/03/anth ropic-is-working-on-a-system-to-prove-ai-models-identity/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
